metadata.description: Repackaged third-party skills (taste-skill, imagegen-skills, img2threejs, web-design-guidelines, RampStack brand) as Claude plugins, synced daily from the upstream repositories.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: tasteskill: the anti-slop frontend skill by Leonxlnx (design-taste-frontend). Professional company websites with one system, real photographs and a real-browser checker.

plugins.name: imagegen-skills
plugins.description: Design image-generation skills by Leonxlnx: website comps, mobile app screens, brand kits and an image-first website pipeline (imagegen-frontend-web, imagegen-frontend-mobile, brandkit, image-to-code).

plugins.name: img2threejs
plugins.description: img2threejs: turn an object or character reference image into a quality-gated, animation-ready procedural Three.js model built in code.

plugins.name: web-design-guidelines
plugins.description: web-design-guidelines by Vercel: review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance (accessibility, UX, best practices). Fetches the latest rules on every review.

plugins.name: rampstack-brand
plugins.description: Brand skills from the RampStack catalog: brand discovery, ideation, archetypes, identity, logo design, style guide and voice.
